hero.title: Shaping Tomorrow's Engineers Where Ancient Wisdom Meets Modern Innovation
hero.subtitle: Elliniki Engineering Academy is a private institution dedicated to advancing engineering education and applied research in the cradle of Western civilization.
about.eyebrow: A New Chapter in Greek Engineering
about.title: Where Innovation Meets a 3,000-Year Tradition of Knowledge
about.p1: Established in November 2025 in the historic Peania district of Attica, Elliniki Engineering Academy is one of Greece's newest private institutions of higher education. Our founders — a coalition of Greek engineering veterans, returning diaspora academics, and European industrial partners — set out to build a school that combines the rigor of European engineering tradition with the agility of a modern technology institute.
about.p2: Though we welcomed our first cohort only six months ago, our 12,000 m² Peania campus, brand-new laboratories, and partnerships across the Athens technology corridor give our 286 founding students a head start few institutions can match.
about.f1: EU-aligned curriculum benchmarked against TU Delft, ETH and NTUA standards
about.f2: Bilingual instruction in Greek and English from day one
about.f3: Student-to-faculty ratio of 8:1 — among the lowest in Greece
about.f4: Located 25 minutes from Athens International Airport
programs.title: Engineering Disciplines for the Decade Ahead
programs.subtitle: Our six founding departments offer rigorous undergraduate and master's programmes designed in close collaboration with European industry partners.
prog.cs.title: Computer & Software Engineering
prog.cs.desc: From algorithms to AI systems engineering — train under faculty drawn from ETH Zürich, NTUA and Athens-based deep-tech founders.
prog.civil.title: Civil & Structural Engineering
prog.civil.desc: Design the infrastructure of a seismic country. Includes a dedicated earthquake-resilience track and a year-long site practicum.
prog.mech.title: Mechanical Engineering
prog.mech.desc: Hands-on labs in robotics, additive manufacturing and propulsion — including access to our new 800 m² Mechatronics Hall.
prog.elec.title: Electrical & Energy Systems
prog.elec.desc: From smart grids to photovoltaics. Greece is rebuilding its energy backbone, and our graduates are being trained to lead it.
prog.env.title: Environmental & Marine Engineering
prog.env.desc: Coastal protection, desalination, blue-economy systems. A discipline shaped by the Aegean itself.
prog.arch.title: Architecture & Built Heritage
prog.arch.desc: A unique programme blending modern structural design with the conservation of Mediterranean architectural heritage.
